steps.code:
# Get album library and downloaded songs
access_token = login_response['access_token']

# Get all albums in library
albums = []
page = 0
while True:
    response = apis.spotify.show_album_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=page, page_limit=20)
    if not response:
        break
    albums.extend(response)
    if len(response) < 20:
        break
    page += 1

print(f"Number of albums: {len(albums)}")

# Get downloaded songs
downloaded = apis.spotify.show_downloaded_songs(access_token=access_token)
print(f"Number of downloaded songs: {len(downloaded)}")
print(downloaded[:2])

steps.code:
# Get details for each album in library to see all songs and durations
for album in albums:
    album_id = album['album_id']
    album_details = apis.spotify.show_album(album_id=album_id)
    print(f"Album {album_id}: {album_details['title']}")
    total_duration = 0
    for song in album_details['songs']:
        # Need to get song duration - we can get from show_song
        song_info = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=song['id'])
        print(f"  Song {song['id']}: {song['title']} duration={song_info['duration']}")
        total_duration += song_info['duration']
    print(f"  Total duration: {total_duration}")
